Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the second essay. The umpires are out in the middle and the India Women players have dispersed onto the field. Laura Wolvaardt and Anne Bosch will open the inning for South Africa Women. Anjali Sarvani has been handed the new ball and will begin proceedings. Let's go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

It is going to be an interesting run chase as the wicket does not seem to be the easiest to bat on. South Africa Women have some good batters in their line up but they need to get off to a good start. There was some spin on offer in the first innings and that should have the India Women spinners excited provided dew does not come into play. Will they continue their momentum and seal a win? Or will the hosts trot over the finish line with ease? We will find out shortly.

Delmi Tucker is up for a chat. She says it is really hard out there as it is hot and it is the first time playing under lights so that was nice. Admits that they didn’t stick to their plans and they slipped a bit. Mentions that she surprised herself with the catch but it just stuck in her hands. Claims that the wicket is good to bat on and she backs the batters to chase it down.

India Women were in trouble at 69 for 5 in the 12th over. Debutant Amanjot Kaur joined hands with Deepti Sharma, who scored 33 runs in 23 balls, in the middle and they added 76 for the 6th wicket. Amanjot Kaur hit some crisp boundaries and ended with 41* off just 30. India Women will be the happier side at the halfway mark. Nonkululeko Mlaba was the pick of the South Africa Women bowlers getting 2 for 15 in her 3 overs. Marizanne Kapp, Ayabonga Khaka, and Delmi Tucker got one a piece as they leaked runs in the final few overs and let India get close to the 150-run mark.

This has been a remarkable recovery for India Women! Amanjot Kaur and Deepti Sharma have helped them post 147 runs on the board and they will know they have enough firepower to be able to defend this. Having put into bat first, they lost their acting skipper early for just 7. Yastika Bhatia and Harleen Deol stayed on for a bit before back-to-back dismissals of the latter and Jemimah Rodrigues had India reeling at 34 for 3. Just as Yastika Bhatia got going, she was bowled by Delmi Tucker in the 10th over for 35 and Devika Vaidya was dismissed soon after.

A good last over by Marizanne Kapp but India Women will be happy with their recovery! Ends the over with a yorker on leg stump. Sneh Rana bunts it down to long on and they run well to complete two runs. India Women have a reasonable total on the board and will believe that they have the bowlers to defend this total.
Sneh Rana comes out to face the last ball.
OUT! The partnership is finally broken but it is a little too late for South Africa Women!
Commentary.Howout: c Ayabonga Khaka b Marizanne Kapp

Commentary.Commentary: This is short and strays down leg. Deepti Sharma pulls this towards deep backward square leg for another brace.

DROPPED! A difficult opportunity but another chance goes begging! Marizanne Kapp bowls a slower delivery full and just outside off. Deepti Sharma lofts this uppishly towards long on. The fielder runs to her right and dives but spills it. Two runs are taken.
Goes full once again and follows the batter as she looks to make room. Amanjot Kaur digs this down to long on for a run.
Marizanne Kapp bowls this full and on the pads. Deepti Sharma hits this uppishly to long on for a single.
FOUR! The third boundary in the over! Amanjot Kaur serves this one full as well and outside off. Amanjot Kaur finds the gap to perfection as she drives this to deep cover four more runs.
FOUR! This has been absolutely thumped! Ayabonga Khaka goes full and outside the off stump. Amanjot Kaur strokes it firmly towards deep cover for four runs.
Goes even wider and on a fuller length. The ball is just inside the tram line as Amanjot Kaur misses her shot.

FOUR! EDGY BOUNDARY! India Women will take all these runs as they get to a fighting total! Ayabonga Khaka bowls this full and wide outside off. Amanjot Kaur goes hard at the ball and gets an outside edge to third man for four runs.
On a yorker length but at the pads. Deepti Sharma digs this out towards deep square leg and takes one.
Ayabonga Khaka bowls this full and on the pads. Deepti Sharma clips this wide of deep square leg and a fumble allows them to take a couple of runs.
Continues bowling full and in line with the stumps. Deepti Sharma powers this down to long on for a run and will retain strike.

FOUR! That has been beautifully timed! Nadine de Klerk bowls a low full toss outside off. Deepti Sharma charges down the pitch and thumps it towards deep cover for four runs. Brings up the 50-run partnership between the two.
Another fullish delivery served outside the off pole. Amanjot Kaur hits this uppishly towards deep cover-point for a single.
WIDE! Bowls this full but strays down leg side. Amanjot Kaur misses her flick and the umpire calls this wide.
A slower ball bowled full and in line with the stumps. Deepti Sharma clips this towards long on and collects one.
Bowls this one back of a length and outside off. Amanjot Kaur smacks this towards cover and a half-stop allows them to take a run.
Nadine de Klerk bowls this full and outside the off stump. Deepti Sharma strokes this towards deep cover and gets only a single.
Slower delivery once again and straight on a fuller length. Deepti Sharma flicks this towards deep sqaure leg and collects one.
Goes full once again and outside off. Amanjot Kaur knocks this to mid off and takes a quick single.

FOUR! A lucky boundary but they all count! Marizanne Kapp bangs this in short and outside off. Amanjot Kaur looks to pull and gets a top edge over the keeper's head for four runs. Sinalo Jafta gets a glove on it but still runs away to the fence.
FOUR! Amanjot Kaur playing quite a cameo here! Marizanne Kapp bowls this full once again and in line with the stumps. Amanjot Kaur knocks this straight over the bowler's head for four runs.

Bowls this full and follows the batter as she looks to make room on the leg side. Amanjot Kaur hits it straight to covet and there is a slight misunderstanding. A direct hit at the striker's end and Amanjot Kaur was a goner.
Marizanne Kapp bowls a slower delivery full and in line with the stumps. Deepti Sharma clips this towards deep square leg for a single.
Another full delivery served in line with the stumps. Amanjot Kaur clips this towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Bowls a full toss outside the off stump. Amanjot Kaur missed out as she hits this straight to the point fielder.
Goes full and outside the off stump, Amanjot Kaur hits this straight to mid off.
Goes really full and angling down leg. Amanjot Kaur shimmies down the wicket and looks to flick it leg side but misses and gets hit on her pads.
FOUR! 100 comes up for India Women! Ayabonga Khaka continues to bowl full and outside off. Amanjot Kaur hits this hard and thumps this to deep cover point for another boundary.
FOUR! Amanjot Kaur gets this one away nicely and is a good start to the over! Ayabonga Khaka bowls this full and outside off. Amanjot Kaur strokes this towards deep backward point for four runs.
Full and slower around off, Amanjot Kaur works it to mid-wicket for one.
Full and outside off, Deepti Sharma drives it to sweeper cover for one.
Full and on the pads, Deepti Sharma tucks it to short fine leg for none.
Back of a length angling into the batter, Amanjot Kaur dabs it to point for one.
Length and a tad outside off, Deepti Sharma punches it to deep cover for one.
Full on off, Amanjot Kaur works it to long-on for one.
SIX! This has been dispatched in style! Delmi Tucker bowls this one full and into the pads. Deepti Sharma hoicks this towards the cow corner fence for a biggie. That should release some pressure.
Flights this one full and just outside off. Amanjot Kaur hits this aerially towards long on for a single.
A low full toss this time and straight. Amanjot Kaur hits this to the right of the bowler who dives and stops it.
Floats this one full and in line with the stumps. Amanjot Kaur dabs this back towards the bowler.
Floats this one full and into the pads. Deepti Sharma flicks this towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Delmi Tucker bowls this short and outside off. Amanjot Kaur cuts this to cover and a misfield allows them to take a single.
Full and hits towards long-on for a couple.
Tossed and spins past the leg stump, Deepti Sharma looks to defend and misses it, so does the keeper. The ball goes down the leg and the batter run for 3 Wides.
Amanjot Kaur eases this through covers for one.
Flighted, Deepti Sharma uses her feet and pulls it to mid-wicket for one.
Good length outside off, Amanjot Kaur square drives it to deep point for one.
Length ball around off, Amanjot Kaur cuts it to short third.
Full toss over the waist height, Amanjot Kaur pulls it straight to the short mid-wicket fielder. She is caught but it's a No-ball and Free-hit coming up.
Short and going down the leg, Deepti Sharma pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Full on the leg peg, Amanjot Kaur looks to flick but wears on the pads.
Length on the pads, Amanjot Kaur tucks it to short mid-wicket.
India Women in massive trouble here and are running out of options.
The debutant Amanjot Kaur walks out to the middle.
OUT! GONE!! CAUGHT! Short and outside off, Devika Vaidya cuts it to short third fielder Delmi Tucker who dives and takes a brilliant catch. India loses their 5 as Devika Vaidya walks back for 9.
Commentary.Howout: c Delmi Tucker b Nonkululeko Mlaba

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller in the channel, Devika Vaidya uses her feet and drives it to covers.
Fuller on off, Devika Vaidya turns it to short mid-wicket.
Tad short and outside off, Devika Vaidya cuts it through the backward point region. Laura Wolvaardt gives the chase and saves two for her side.
Devika Vaidya takes it on the full and mistimes it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Tad short around off, Deepti Sharma pulls it to mid-wicket for one.
Fuller on off. Devika Vaidya uses her feet and works it down to long-off for one.
Tossed around off, Deepti Sharma tucks it to square leg for one.
Fuller on off, Devika Vaidya looks to sweep and gets a top edge which falls in front of the short fine leg fielder for one.
Dragged on down the leg. Devika Vaidya turns it to short fine leg for none.
India Women need to get a partnership going here if they want to have any chance in this game.
Flighted full and outside the off stump. Devika Vaidya knocks this to wide long off for a run and will keep strike.
Low full toss on off, Deepti Sharma works it down to long-off to get off the mark with one.

DRINKS! The players will take a refreshment break and India Women will not be thrilled with their effort here. They have their work cut out if they are to put a reasonable total on the board. South Africa Women will be looking to take some more quick wickets and keep India Women on the back foot.
Deepti Sharma needs to play a big knock here and bail her team out of trouble.

OUT! TIMBER! Delmi Tucker gets the breakthrough and this has been an inspired bowling change by South Africa Women! Delmi Tucker bowls this one slightly short and into the stumps. Yastika Bhatia goes on the back foot and looks to push this away but plays the wrong line. The ball takes a slight inside edge and shatters the stumps. Yastika Bhatia was looking good here and it is a massive blow for India Women as they lose their fourth wicket.
This is short as well and in line with the stumps. Yastika Bhatia tucks this towards deep backward square leg for a couple of runs.
This is short as well and into the stumps. Devika Vaidya clips this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Sune Luus trying out all her bowling options.
Delmi Tucker bowls this slightly short and outside off. Devika Vaidya rocks back and dabs this towards point.
FOUR! Yastika Bhatia looking to be positive now! Masabata Klaas bowls this short and just outside off. Yastika Bhatia pulls this hard towards deep square leg for four runs.

SIX! That is a splendid shot from Yastika Bhatia! She had premeditated this shot and executes it to perfection. Masabata Klaas bowls this on a good length and in line with the stumps. Yastika Bhatia steps well across the stumps and paddles this over fine leg for a maximum.
On a good length this time and outside the off pole. Devika Vaidya strokes this to deep point for a single.
Bowls this one back of a length and just outside off. Devika Vaidya pulls this straight to mid-wicket.
Continues bowling on a good length and outside the off stump. Devika Vaidya knocks this straight to point.
This is on a good length and outside off. Devika Vaidya looks to drive but is beaten.

Back to bowling on a good length and outside off. Yastika Bhatia slashes at the ball once again and this time is beaten. There is a stifled appeal from the wicket-keeper and the bowler but the umpire remains unmoved.
A touch shorter this time and still outside off. Yastika Bhatia cuts this towards deep point and picks up a couple of runs.
Goes full this time and outside the off pole. Yastika Bhatia looks to heave this away but gets an inside edge onto her pads.
Bowls this on a good length and outside off. Yastika Bhatia dabs this towards point.
Length and angling outside off, Yastika Bhatia uses her feet and misses on the drive.
FOUR!! SMACKED!! Length around off, Yastika Bhatia pulls it through the wide long-on region for a boundary. Excellent batting.
Fuller on off. Yastika Bhatia drives it hard down the ground for a single to long-off.
FOUR!! DELICATE!! Length outside off, Yastika Bhatia plays it with soft hands as the ball races to the third man region for a boundary.
Full on the pads, Devika Vaidya turns it to mid-wicket for one.
Devika Vaidya comes out to bat at number 5.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! ANother one bites the dust and South Africa Women have two wickets in two balls! Jemimah Rodrigues poor run of form continues. This is short as well and going down leg. Jemimah Rodrigues looks to pull this fine but gets a faint glove as it goes through to the keeper. Sinalo Jafta holds on to the ball well and appeals while the bowler is not sure. The umpire raises his finger and the batter has to depart. India Women have lost three wickets in quick time.
Commentary.Howout: c Sinalo Jafta b Nonkululeko Mlaba

Commentary.Commentary: Jemimah Rodrigues walks out to bat.

OUT! RUN OUT! South Africa Women get a big wicket here and it is courtesy of a brilliant piece of fielding! Nonkululeko Mlaba bowls this short and down leg. Harleen Deol works this down to fine leg and looks for a couple of runs. Ayabonga Khaka collects the ball and throws at the keepr's end. Gets a direct hit and Harleen Deol is short depsite a dive. India Women lose their second wicket.

FOUR! Harleen Deol looks to be aggressive here! Nonkululeko Mlaba flights this one full and outside the off stump. Harleen Deol shimmies down the wicket and goes hard at the ball. Harleen Deol slices this towards deep backward point for four runs.
Full again on the leg stump, Yastika Bhatia plays across the line and misses. Huge appeal from Ayabonga Khaka but it is pitching outside leg.
Full and on off, Harleen Deol  turns it to mid-wicket and runs through for a quick single.
Length ball on the middle and leg, Yastika Bhatia pushes it to mid-on for one.
Back of a length on the stumps, Yastika Bhatia pulls it past the mid-wicket fielder and allows the batter to take two.
Tad fuller on off, Yastika Bhatia drives it to mid-on.
Length and down the leg, Yastika Bhatia looks to pull and the ball clips her pads on her way through to the keeper.
Slower and full around off, Harleen Deol clips it to mid-on for none.
Fuller on off, Yastika Bhatia pushes it to mid-on for one.
Length and angling down the leg, Yastika Bhatia misses on the pull and wears on the pad. A stifled appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Fuller and outside off, Yastika Bhatia heaves it to the deep mid-wicket region. The fielder from mid-on gives the chase and keeps it to two.
Length outside off, Yastika Bhatia cuts it to point.
Fuller in the channel, Harleen Deol works it to fine leg for one.
Marizanne Kapp is brought back into the attack.
Short again outside off, Yastika Bhatia pulls it to deep square leg and an outstanding fielding effort at the boundary from Marizanne Kapp keeps it to two.
Short and angling down the leg, Harleen Deol pulls it to a short fine leg for one.
Short and wide outside off, Harleen Deol cuts it hard to point but cannot beat Laura Wolvaardt stationed there.
Full and into the blockhole, Harleen Deol digs it out and plays back to Masabata Klaas
Similar delivery again and Yastika Bhatia cuts it this time to third man for one.
Length delivery angling outside off, Yastika Bhatia misses out on the cut short.
Length and down the leg. Yastika Bhatia goes for the pull and misses. Wide signaled!

DROPPED! Length ball on off, Yastika Bhatia advances down the track and hits it high up in the air. The ball goes to Laura Wolvaardt and she spills down the sitter. Yastika Bhatia gets a reprive and a single taken.
Full again shaping into the batter. Harleen Deol tucks it to short mid-wicket and takes off for a single.
Harleen Deol makes her way out to the middle at number 3.

OUT! GONE!! IN THE AIR AND TAKEN! The acting skipper Smriti Mandhana departs. Fuller one on off. Smriti Mandhana looks to loft it straight but cannot go over Chloe Tryon at mid-off. She takes it nicely and India Women lose their first wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Chloe Tryon b Ayabonga Khaka

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball outside off, Smriti Mandhana cuts it to the backward point fielder.
FOUR!! SHOT!! Short of a length around off. Smriti Mandhana uses her feet and pulls it to the deep mid-wicket fence for four.
Fuller on off, Smriti Mandhana drives it to mid-off.
Length outside off, Yastika Bhatia pulls it to square leg.
Length outside off. Goes on with the arm, Yastika Bhatia plays and misses.

Good length outside the off stump, Yastika Bhatia shuffles a long way outside off and misses a pull getting it off the pad to point. Mandhana looks for a single but is sent back from halfway down the pitch. A direct hit at the bowler's end but she is back in the crease.
Short of a length outside off, Smriti Mandhana works it between cover and point. Takes a single.
Length ball outside off, Smriti Mandhana punches it to covers.
Tad short on the stumps. Smriti Mandhana pulls it past the square-leg fielder as she fails to hold on to it and the batters take two.
Nadine de Klerk will bowl from the other end.
Comes into the batter on a good length. Yastika Bhatia defends this to the right of the bowler.
Full once again and outside off. Yastika Bhatia looks to drive but is beaten.
Goes a touch fuller and wide outside off. Yastika Bhatia leaves this one alone.
This is on a good length and in line with the stumps. Yastika Bhatia blocks this back towards the bowler.
Goes full this time and angles this into the pads. Yastika Bhatia clips this towards deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Bowls this on a good length and angled into the stumps. Yastika Bhatia blocks this towards cover.
Marizanne Kapp maybe slightly rusty after a long lay off.

FIVE WIDES! Poor start from Marizanne Kapp as India Women have been gifted free runs to begin proceedings! She bowls this full and straying down leg from 'round the wicket. The wicket-keeper is unable to hold onto this and it goes for four extra runs. The umpire calls this wide.

We are done with the pre-match formalities and are all set for the game to begin. The umpires are out in the middle as the South Africa Women players take their respective fielding positions on the field. Yastika Bhatia and Smriti Mandhana are out in the middle to open for India Women while Marizanne Kapp will start the proceedings for South Africa Women. Here we go...

We are moments away from the start of the game but first the two sets of players line up for their respective national anthems. It will be India's national anthem first followed by the national anthem of South Africa.

Jemimah Rodrigues will have a word as well. She says cricket is all about picking after a fall. Claims that she is batting well so back herself to come back stronger. Mentions that they are taking positives from the last tournament where they played a young squad. Adds that they figured what areas need to be worked on and they have done so. Reckons that it is a great advantage that they have matches before the World Cup and they want to build momentum so they need to make the most of these games and learn from it.

Marizanne Kapp is up for a chat and she says that the team management asked her to take a break which is good for her body. Mentions that it has been a while since she played an intentional T20 and is a little nervous but it is good to have a few games before the World Cup. Claims that they want to prepare as best they can prepare for the mega event and that is what they are looking at in this series. Ends by saying that the wicket is going to be a bit slow but hopefully can put up a fight.

South Africa Women (Playing XI) - Anne Bosch, Laura Wolvaardt, Marizanne Kapp, Sune Luus (C), Chloe Tryon, Delmi Tucker, Nadine de Klerk, Sinalo Jafta (WK), Ayabonga Khaka, Masabata Klaas, Nonkululeko Mlaba.

India Women (Playing XI) - Smriti Mandhana (C), Yastika Bhatia (WK), Harleen Deol, Jemimah Rodrigues, Devika Vaidya, Deepti Sharma, Amanjot Kaur, Sneh Rana, Radha Yadav, Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Anjali Sarvani.
TOSS - The captains are out in the middle. The coin is flipped into the air and lands in favor of South Africa Women. They have elected to BOWL first.

Amanjot Kaur receives her T20I cap from Smriti Mandhana and she is all smiles as she is set to make her debut. She is a seam bowler who is more than handy with the bat and her inclusion may indicate that Pooja Vastrakar may still not be fit enough to start this game.

Cricket lovers all around the world have been treated to some of the exciting leagues and tournaments that are currently going on, and now we shift our focus to the South Africa Women's T20I Tri-Series, where India Women and West Indies Women will challenge the hosts. The first match will be a tasty encounter between the Women in Blue and the Proteas Women, which will be played at the Buffalo Park in East London, South Africa. India Women are coming into this series after suffering from being dominated by the Aussies in their own backyard. However, they showed glimpses of their quality in that series and gave Australia Women a tough fight in a couple of games. They will be without their star opener Shafali Verma and power hitter Richa Ghosh, who are representing India at the U-19 Women's T20 World Cup, but still have enough firepower in the batting lineup with the likes of Smriti Mandhana, Harmanpreet Kaur, and Jemimah Rodrigues. Deepti Sharma will be crucial with her all-around abilities, while Meghna Singh and Anjali Sarvani will be their frontline bowlers. They have also added Shikha Pandey after a long absence, and it will be interesting to see how she performs with the mega event not far away. They'll be hoping to bounce back from the Australia series with a win here. South Africa Women, on the other hand, has not enjoyed much success in the shortest format and will look to change that. They will be led by a top-quality batter, Sune Luus. However, their key player will be Laura Wolvaardt, who has been a consistent performer for them in all formats. They will also expect Anne Bosch and Marizanne Kapp to provide support and maintain balance in their batting order. However, their main weapons are in their bowling department, as Ayabonga Khaka and Shabnim Ismail will be important for them to get through the Indian batting line-up. They will also have the crowd's support and will hope to start the series with a victory. However, the purpose of this series for all three teams will be to get themselves ready for the upcoming Women's T20 World Cup. The three teams will be seen testing their squads, getting accustomed to the conditions, and most importantly, preparing themselves well before the all-important tournament. With India Women and South Africa Women going head-to-head in the first game, we can expect a fiery clash. Let's see who comes out on top.
